info.name: Generate a Button Shortlink for an Amazon URL

items.docs:
Generate and return a Button-templated shortlink that redirects to an Amazon page. This link can then be used by a Creator to link an Amazon product and make attributed purchases.

NOTE: Please reach out to your Button representative after configuring this on your end, as we will need to add your organization to an allowlist to fully enable functionality.
